privateData.description: This is the encrypted values of aliasName + note + displayHidden encoded as an array in cbor

avatarHash.description: SHA256 hash of the bytes of the image specified by avatarUrl

avatarFingerprint.description: dHash the image specified by avatarUrl

corePaymentAddress.description: Core chain address in storage form (type byte 0x00 P2PKH / 0x01 P2SH followed by the 20-byte HASH160, i.e. RIPEMD160 of SHA256, of the public key or redeem script) for public payments. The type byte is consensus-enforced by a data trigger; clients render the address as Base58Check for the network they are on. Payments to it are publicly linkable to this profile.

platformPaymentAddress.description: Platform address in storage form (type byte 0x00 P2PKH / 0x01 P2SH followed by the 20-byte HASH160, i.e. RIPEMD160 of SHA256, of the public key or redeem script) for public payments. The type byte is consensus-enforced by a data trigger.

shieldedAddress.description: Raw Orchard receiving address: 11-byte diversifier followed by 32-byte diversified transmission key. Clients validate before payment; wallets should use a dedicated tip account.

withdrawal.description: Withdrawal document to track underlying withdrawal transactions. Withdrawals should be created with IdentityWithdrawalTransition

transactionIndex.description: Sequential index of asset unlock (withdrawal) transaction. Populated when a withdrawal pooled into withdrawal transaction

transactionSignHeight.description: The Core height on which transaction was signed

coreFeePerByte.description: This is the fee that you are willing to spend for this transaction in Duffs/Byte

pooling.description: This indicated the level at which Platform should try to pool this transaction

status.description: 0 - Pending, 1 - Signed, 2 - Broadcasted, 3 - Complete, 4 - Expired, 5 - Failed

rewardShare.description: Share specified percentage of masternode rewards with identities

keyIndex.description: The derivation index used to create the encryption key.

encryptionKeyIndex.description: The secondary index used to derive the encryption key that is used to encrypt and decrypt encryptedData.

burnFromId.description: The identifier of the identity from which tokens will be burned

note.description: An optional explanation of why this burn took place

recipientType.description: Recipient type: 0 = ContractOwner, 1 = Identity, 2 = EvonodesByParticipation. A once-per-identity claim records 1 = Identity with the claimant as recipientId.

recipientId.description: An identity ID for direct recipient distributions

distributionType.description: The type of distribution (0: PreProgrammed, 1: Perpetual, 2: OncePerIdentity)

note.description: An optional explanation for this release

changeItem.description: The change item in serialized form

note.description: An optional explanation for this config update

frozenIdentityId.description: The identity Id of the frozen token account

destroyedAmount.description: The amount that was frost burned

note.description: An optional explanation for destroying these frozen funds

priceSchedule.description: The serialized price schedule for direct token purchases

note.description: An optional explanation for the pricing change

purchaseCost.description: The cost paid for the tokens in credits

action.description: The action we are performing (0: Pause, 1: Resume)

note.description: An optional explanation for this emergency action

frozenIdentityId.description: The identity Id of the frozen token account

note.description: An optional explanation for this identity freeze
An optional explanation of why this mint took place

toIdentityId.description: The identity or the group Id

encryptedPersonalNote.description: An optional encrypted explanation of why this transfer took place only meant for the sender

encryptedSharedNote.description: An optional encrypted explanation of why this transfer took place shared between the sender and the receiver

publicNote.description: An optional public explanation of why this transfer took place

senderKeyIndex.description: Used with the encrypted shared note

recipientKeyIndex.description: Used with the encrypted shared note

rootEncryptionKeyIndex.description: Used with the encrypted private note

derivationEncryptionKeyIndex.description: Used with the encrypted private note

frozenIdentityId.description: The identity Id of the frozen token account

note.description: An optional explanation for this identity unfreeze

contractKeywords.description: Keywords associated with the contract allowing for better searchability. This document type can be deleted but not manually created nor updated. Creation occurs automatically internally on DataContractCreate and mirrors the contract's keywords field. It can be updated with DataContractUpdate.

fullDescription.description: Full description of the contract. This document type is mutable but creation is not allowed. Creation occurs automatically internally on DataContractCreate and mirrors the contract's description field initially.

shortDescription.description: Short description of the contract. This document type is mutable but creation is not allowed. Creation occurs automatically internally on DataContractCreate and mirrors the contract's description field initially.
